scope: Downstream compact initial-surroundings predictor; independent of completing archive descriptions.
physical_reason: Well-supported opening contrasts were positive in the held source and target. The 3.40 packing-adjusted 95% parent interval [0.004546,0.005380] is below the registered 0.02 absolute first-observed risk margin at 1M sweeps.
numerical_reason: Stock scalar failures and one-step optimizer disagreement on fixed numerical controls. Historical failing critic tensors were not retained.
scope_of_inference: The opening observable carries a detectable conditional association, not a causal cage lifetime or a phase. Failure of the practical margin is not absence of association.
